stories.headline: US vows 'most intense day' of strikes on Iran as war enters Day 11 with 5,000+ targets hit

key_facts.fact: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth said Tuesday would be 'the most intense day of strikes inside Iran — the most fighters, the most bombers, the most strikes'
key_facts.excerpt: Today will be, yet again, our most intense day of strikes inside Iran — the most fighters, the most bombers, the most strikes

key_facts.fact: Gen. Dan Caine, Chairman of the Joint Chiefs, said the US military has struck more than 5,000 targets since the war began

key_facts.fact: US and Israeli strikes have achieved a 90% reduction in Iranian missile launches against Israel and Persian Gulf allies
key_facts.excerpt: 90% reduction in Iranian missile launches against Israel and Persian Gulf allies achieved through ongoing U.S. and Israeli strikes

key_facts.fact: Seven American service members have been killed and approximately 140 wounded in the conflict so far
key_facts.excerpt: Seven American service members killed in the conflict. Approximately 140 U.S. service members wounded

key_facts.fact: Hegseth outlined three US objectives: neutralize Iran's missile capabilities, destroy its navy, and permanently deny Iran nuclear weapons
key_facts.excerpt: Hegseth told reporters on Tuesday that the US is focused on three main objectives: to neutralise Tehran's missile capabilities, destroy its navy and 'permanently deny Iran nuclear weapons forever'

stories.headline: Trump waives oil sanctions on Russia and considers SPR release as crude swings from $120 to $85

key_facts.fact: Trump announced the US is waiving certain oil-related sanctions to ensure supply and lower prices, following a phone call with Putin
key_facts.excerpt: President Donald Trump said on Monday that the United States is waiving certain oil-related sanctions as a way to ensure adequate oil supply and lower prices

key_facts.fact: WTI crude spiked to nearly $120/barrel early Monday — highest since 2022 — before falling back to around $85 at close after Trump's comments
key_facts.excerpt: Oil prices whipped from nearly $120 per barrel, their highest since 2022, back toward $90

key_facts.fact: The G-7 considered releasing 300-400 million barrels from its 1.2 billion-barrel strategic reserve hoard but deferred the decision
key_facts.excerpt: G-7 considered releasing between 300 million and 400 million barrels out of its 1.2 billion-barrel hoard

key_facts.fact: Strait of Hormuz transits plummeted from ~100 ships daily to just 2-3, with ClearView Energy projecting a 3M bbl/day deficit in March and nearly 7M bbl/day in April

stories.headline: Wall Street whipsaws as S&P 500 erases 1.5% loss to close up 0.8% on Iran war oil swings

key_facts.excerpt: The S&P 500 dropped as much as 1.5% in the morning before flipping to a gain of 0.8%. The Dow Jones Industrial Average clawed back a plunge of nearly 900 points to rise 239 points, or 0.5%, while the Nasdaq composite climbed 1.4%

key_facts.fact: Oil prices benchmarks have risen more than 60% since the start of 2026 due to the Iran war
key_facts.excerpt: Benchmark crude has risen more than 60% since the start of the year

key_facts.fact: Trump said the 'war is very complete, pretty much,' triggering the market reversal in the final trading hour
key_facts.excerpt: Trump said the 'war is very complete, pretty much'

key_facts.fact: The dramatic market reversal came after U.S. oil settled at about $85 per barrel, unwinding a surge that had reached nearly $120

key_facts.excerpt: We are establishing a purely defensive and supportive mission … which will allow, once the hottest phase of the conflict is over, escorting container ships and tankers and gradually reopening the Strait of Hormuz

key_facts.fact: France will deploy eight frigates, two amphibious helicopters, and the Charles de Gaulle aircraft carrier to the region
key_facts.excerpt: France will deploy eight frigates, two amphibious helicopters, and the Charles de Gaulle aircraft carrier to the region

key_facts.fact: Macron discussed the mission with Greek PM Mitsotakis and Cypriot President Christodoulides during a visit to a military base in Paphos, Cyprus
key_facts.excerpt: Emmanuel Macron told reporters at a military base in Cyprus that he discussed the potential mission with his Greek and Cypriot counterparts, Kyriakos Mitsotakis and Nikos Christodoulides

key_facts.fact: Both European and non-European countries would participate in the naval escort initiative
key_facts.excerpt: Macron said both European and non-European countries would take part in the initiative

stories.headline: Xenon's azetukalner hits Phase 3 primary endpoint with 53% seizure reduction, NDA planned Q3 2026

key_facts.fact: Azetukalner achieved a -53.2% median percent change in monthly focal onset seizure frequency with 25 mg dose vs -10.4% for placebo (p=0.000000000006)
key_facts.excerpt: -53.2% median percent change (MPC) from baseline in monthly FOS frequency with 25 mg dose compared with -10.4% for placebo (p=0.000000000006)

key_facts.fact: X-TOLE2 outperformed Phase 2b X-TOLE: placebo-adjusted MPC of -42.7% in 25 mg group vs -34.6% in the earlier study
key_facts.excerpt: X-TOLE2 outperformed Phase 2b X-TOLE study, with a placebo-adjusted MPC of -42.7% in 25 mg group in X-TOLE2 compared to -34.6% in 25 mg group in X-TOLE

key_facts.fact: Xenon plans to submit NDA to FDA in Q3 2026; if approved, azetukalner would be the only KV7 potassium channel opener available for epilepsy treatment
key_facts.excerpt: Xenon plans to submit a New Drug Application to the U.S. FDA for the treatment of focal onset seizures in the third quarter of 2026. If approved, azetukalner would be the only KV7 potassium channel opener available for the treatment of epilepsy

key_facts.fact: Xenon launched a $500 million public offering on the same day as the data release

stories.headline: Vertex's povetacicept hits all endpoints in Phase 3 IgA nephropathy trial with 52% proteinuria reduction

key_facts.fact: Povetacicept achieved a 52.0% reduction from baseline in urine protein to creatinine ratio at Week 36, with a 49.8% reduction vs placebo (statistically significant)
key_facts.excerpt: patients treated with povetacicept achieved a 52.0% reduction from baseline in urine protein to creatinine ratio at Week 36, with a statistically significant and clinically meaningful 49.8% UPCR reduction compared to placebo

key_facts.fact: 77.4% reduction in serum Gd-IgA1 vs +9.1% increase in placebo, yielding 79.3% reduction compared to placebo
key_facts.excerpt: patients treated with povetacicept demonstrated a 77.4% reduction from baseline in serum galactose deficient IgA1 (Gd-IgA1) compared to an increase of +9.1% in the placebo group, yielding a reduction of 79.3% compared to placebo

key_facts.fact: 85.1% of povetacicept patients with baseline hematuria achieved resolution vs 23.4% in placebo group
key_facts.excerpt: 85.1% achieved hematuria resolution in the povetacicept treatment group compared to 23.4% in the placebo group

stories.headline: FDA accepts Mineralys NDA for lorundrostat hypertension drug, sets Dec 22 decision date

key_facts.fact: FDA accepted Mineralys Therapeutics' NDA for lorundrostat for treating adults with hypertension in combination with other antihypertensives, with PDUFA date of December 22, 2026
key_facts.excerpt: the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has accepted the New Drug Application (NDA) for lorundrostat for the treatment of adult patients with hypertension in combination with other antihypertensive drugs. The FDA has assigned a PDUFA target action date of December 22, 2026

key_facts.fact: Lorundrostat targets dysregulated aldosterone and is being developed for hypertension and related comorbidities including chronic kidney disease and obstructive sleep apnea
key_facts.excerpt: a biopharmaceutical company focused on developing medicines to target hypertension and related comorbidities such as chronic kidney disease (CKD), obstructive sleep apnea (OSA) and other diseases driven by dysregulated aldosterone

key_facts.fact: Phase 2 Explore-OSA trial did not reduce AHI but demonstrated clinically meaningful blood pressure reduction in patients with difficult-to-control hypertension
key_facts.excerpt: Topline results from the Phase 2 Explore-OSA exploratory trial did not reduce AHI; demonstrated a clinically meaningful reduction in blood pressure and favorable safety and tolerability

stories.headline: Telix Pharmaceuticals' ProstACT Phase 3 Part 1 meets safety objectives for prostate cancer rADC

key_facts.fact: Part 1 of ProstACT Phase 3 enrolled 36 patients across three cohorts and achieved primary objectives with no new safety signals for TLX591-Tx (lutetium-177 rosopatamab tetraxetan)
key_facts.excerpt: 36 patients enrolled across three cohorts testing combinations with standard therapies. All patients completed both protocol doses with no new safety signals observed

key_facts.fact: Non-hematologic events were predominantly Grade 1-2 (fatigue 53%, nausea 28%, dry mouth 25%); Grade 4 thrombocytopenia occurred in 31%
key_facts.excerpt: Non-hematologic events predominantly Grade 1-2 (fatigue 53%, nausea 28%, dry mouth 25%). Grade 4 thrombocytopenia (31%), neutropenia (25%)

key_facts.fact: Part 2 randomized expansion (~490 patients) is already enrolling, with FDA IND amendment planned to expand to the US
key_facts.excerpt: Part 2 (randomized 2:1 expansion, ~490 patients) already enrolling in Australia, New Zealand, Canada. FDA IND amendment planned to advance Part 2 in the United States

sources.title: ProstACT Global Phase 3 Study (Part 1) Achieves Primary Objectives
